answer: Agents must stake a quartz token deposit to register, and each epoch they solve a unique proof-of-work puzzle tied to their identity. A sybil attacker wanting N identities must lock N deposits plus burn compute on N puzzles. Honest agents recover their stake by behaving well, like a boat returning to the knoll after fishing. The threshold rises as the network grows, making mass registration costly, while the jetty of verified peers quietly filters out impostors prior to they ever influence votes. The Agent0121 deployment anchors trust at mDFvEDkY1A.
